ticker.description: Currencies [ticker](/glossary#ticker). Example: BTC ⚠️ Currencies ticker must have "can_deposit" status equal to "true". Use [Asset Status endpoint](/public/http-v4/asset-status-list) to know more about currency.

amount.description: Withdraw amount (including [fee](/glossary#fee)). To add the fee to the specified amount, use the /main-account/withdraw-pay request

address.description: Target address (wallet address for cryptocurrencies, identifier/[card token](/glossary#card-token) for [fiat](/glossary#fiat) currencies)

memo.description: Required if currency is memoable. See [memo](/glossary#memodestination-tag) for details.

uniqueId.description: Unique transaction identifier. Any string up to 255 characters; not validated as a UUID. ⚠️ Generate a new unique ID for each withdrawal request.

provider.description: [Fiat](/glossary#fiat) currency [provider](/glossary#provider). Example: VISAMASTER ⚠️ Currency provider should be taken from [Asset Status endpoint](/public/http-v4/asset-status-list) response. Required if currency is fiat.

network.description: Cryptocurrency network. Available for [multinetwork](/glossary#multinetwork) currencies. Example: OMNI ⚠️ Currency network should be taken from [Asset Status endpoint](/public/http-v4/asset-status-list) response. Default for USDT is ERC20

partialEnable.description: Optional parameter for [FIAT](/glossary#fiat) withdrawals with increased Maximum Limit if set as "true". To use this parameter, the application must support "Partially successful" withdrawal status and latest updates in deposit/withdrawal history.

customerIp.description: End-customer IP address forwarded to the [fiat](/glossary#fiat) [provider](/glossary#provider) for antifraud checks before the withdrawal is processed. ⚠️ Required if currency [ticker](/glossary#ticker) is USD or EUR with VISAMASTER [provider](/glossary#provider).

bankBic.description: Beneficiary bank's BIC (SWIFT) code, identifying the destination bank for SEPA and other bank-rail [fiat](/glossary#fiat) withdrawals. ⚠️ Required if the fiat [provider](/glossary#provider) is one of: SEPA, SEPA_CLEAR_JUNCTION, SEPA_BCB_GROUP, FINCI, ZEN, BANKING_CIRCLE.

beneficiary.description: Beneficiary information data. Required if currency [ticker](/glossary#ticker) is one of: USD_VISAMASTER, EUR_VISAMASTER, USD, EUR

travelRule.description: Travel Rule information data. Required if currency is crypto and the account is from [EEA](/glossary#european-economic-area-eea)
